WS::message
Description
WS::message drop Drop an entire Websocket message.
Syntax
WS::message ( 'drop' )
WS::message ( ‘drop’ )
Valid During
WS_CLIENT_FRAME WS_SERVER_FRAME
Examples
when
WS_CLIENT_FRAME
{
WS
::
message
drop
}
when
WS_SERVER_FRAME
{
WS
::
message
drop
}
